StitchOptions.description: Shared, portable controls for a local adjacent-pair panorama stitch.

fields.quality: Requested mobile or HD output quality tier.
fields.analysisMaxSide: Maximum long side in pixels used only for feature analysis.
fields.maxFeatures: Maximum ORB features extracted per image.
fields.ratioThreshold: Lowe ratio threshold for KNN feature matching.
fields.maxMedianErrorPx: Maximum accepted median reprojection error in pixels.
fields.exposureGain: Inclusive exposure gain clamp for overlap correction.
fields.blendWidthPx: Feather width in pixels at the seam.
fields.outputMegapixels: Maximum output megapixels for mobile and HD exports.
fields.warningThresholds: Warn when source count or source megapixels exceeds these values.
fields.jpegQuality: Default JPEG quality expressed as 0 to 1.

MatchMetrics.description: Quality measurements produced for one adjacent image pair.

fields.pairIndex: Zero-based left image index for the adjacent pair.
fields.ratioMatchCount: Matches remaining after the ratio filter.
fields.inlierRatio: RANSAC inliers divided by mutually consistent matches.
fields.medianReprojectionErrorPx: Median inlier reprojection error in pixels.
